market.question: Who will win in the upcoming esports event Galions vs Kaufland Hangry Knights scheduled for October 9, 2026 at 4:00 PM UTC?
market.description: This market will settle to Yes if Galions wins the Galions vs Kaufland Hangry Knights LoL match scheduled for October 9, 2026 at 4:00 PM UTC. If the match is delayed, postponed, or suspended and not rescheduled to a date within two weeks of the originally scheduled date, the market will settle to the last fair market price. Outcome sourced from Riot Games.

market.question: BTC Up or Down 15m
market.description: This market will settle to Up if the Bitcoin price at 12:30AM ET on Oct 9, 2026 is greater than or equal to the price at 12:15AM ET on Oct 9, 2026. Otherwise, this market will settle to Down. Outcome sourced from CF Benchmarks' Bitcoin Real-Time Index (BRTI), available at https://www.cfbenchmarks.com/data/indices/BRTI. The price at the beginning and at the end of the time range is determined the same way: in the last minute before each of those two times, 60 BRTI prices are collected. The official value for that time is the simple average of these prices, rounded to the nearest 2 decimal places. Please note that this market is about the price according to CF Benchmarks' BRTI, not according to other sources or spot markets.
